messages:
Sam: heads-up — fincorp asked for a faster private deploy path and is pushing for end of quarter. wondering if we should treat as X-impact RICE or a customer-specific spike.
Lucy: can we surface the ask in RICE terms? I think it looks high impact but heavy infra deps.
Amir: quick calc from my perspective: Reach=2 (single customer), Impact=8 (enterprise revenue + reference), Confidence=5 (we know requirements), Effort=13 engineer-weeks across infra + runtime. RICE ~ (2*8*5)/13 ≈ 6.15 -> medium.
Dena: important note — Dedicated infra team already has a queued rollout for multi-tenant isolation this sprint. If we preempt, we push that backlog.
Jorge: both infra and eng-runtime have cross-team tests: VPC routing, KMS, and canary hooks. Realistic timeline if we force it = 8-10 weeks.
Sam: ok so tradeoff is immediate customer win vs delaying planned improvements that unblock 3 other customers.
Lucy: suggestion: propose a phased delivery. Phase 1 = minimal private control-plane shim + audit logging; Phase 2 = full on-prem package. Phase 1 maybe 3-4 weeks if we deprioritize smaller internal items.
Amir: +1 for phased. But need to quantify sequencing cost. If phase1 uses 40% of infra cycles, that will ripple. Who owns the queue reprioritization? @Dena?
Dena: I can run a fast queuing simulation with current capacity numbers. If we carve 40% for phase1, estimated delay on other tickets = 4 sprints. I’ll post numbers by EOD.
Sam: customers care about SLA and security. Can we offer an interim SLA (best-effort) and a paid acceleration option? Sales will like that.
Jorge: Sales handoff needs realistic launch criteria: KMS integration working end-to-end, traceability, and successful canary on dedicated pool. Without those we should not sign a formal SLA.
Lucy: this is classic impact-vs-effort conflict. For prioritization meeting: bring RICE numbers for both phase options, the queue delay estimate, and a proposed canary plan.
Amir: I’ll prepare a condensed RICE sheet: phase1 vs phase2 vs do-nothing. Also include cost delta for using dedicated reserved capacity vs hosted temporary burst.
Priya-bot: Reminder: please attach any customer legal asks to the thread (Fincorp NDA + SOC2 notes).
Sam: assigned action items — Amir RICE sheet, Dena queue sim, Jorge canary/runbook checklist, Lucy draft sales offer. Sync 1pm tomorrow to decide sequencing. :calendar: :thumbsup:
Lucy: noted. If we greenlight phase1, ask infra to freeze noncritical merges for 1 sprint to reduce churn.
Dena: will run the sim now and ping infra leads.
Jorge: adding a dependency tag to the tickets so the rollout board shows blocked items.
Amir: one more thought — can we reuse parts of the Dedicated work scheduled this quarter to reduce incremental effort? I'll map overlaps in the sheet.
Sam: thanks all. keep replies short; this will be the decision thread.
